title: Energy ontology
description: Portable energy semantics imported from the Lattice industry ontology.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Ontology
metadata:
  name: energy
  title: Energy Ontology
  description: Fundamental entities and relationships shared across Energy decision contracts.
  version: 0.1.0
  source:
    system: lattice
    sourceId: energy-ontology
    sourceVersion: 0.1.0
    sourceDigest: sha256:edb4eab64c4b8b1bca56a39f74250d6ba9defcc7d5778fc397526167847bd4c4
spec:
  types:
    - id: grid_asset
      label: Grid Asset
      description: A governed physical or virtual asset participating in grid operations.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0
      properties:
        - id: grid_asset.asset_id
          label: Asset Id
          description: Stable asset identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/0
        - id: grid_asset.asset_type
          label: Asset Type
          description: Imported Asset Type property.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/1
        - id: grid_asset.operational_status
          label: Operational Status
          description: Imported Operational Status property.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/0/properties/2
    - id: outage_event
      label: Outage Event
      description: A disruption affecting one or more grid assets.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1
      properties:
        - id: outage_event.event_id
          label: Event Id
          description: Imported Event Id property.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/0
        - id: outage_event.started_at
          label: Started At
          description: Imported Started At property.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/1
        - id: outage_event.severity
          label: Severity
          description: Imported Severity property.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/1/properties/2
    - id: well
      label: Well
      description: A governed well across drilling, completion, and production.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2
      properties:
        - id: well.completion_date
          label: Completion Date
          description: Date completion operations finished or report was signed.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/0
        - id: well.completion_type
          label: Completion Type
          description: Completion type such as hydraulic fracture, open hole, perforated casing, or recompletion.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/1
        - id: well.measured_depth
          label: Measured Depth
          description: Measured depth at report cutoff.
          dataType: decimal
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/2
        - id: well.well_name
          label: Well Name
          description: Well name and number.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/3
        - id: well.api_well_number
          label: Api Well Number
          description: API well number or other regulatory well identifier.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/4
        - id: well.casing_status
          label: Casing Status
          description: Casing, cementing, or liner status.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/5
        - id: well.choke_size
          label: Choke Size
          description: Initial production test choke size.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/6
        - id: well.field_name
          label: Field Name
          description: Field, pool, or reservoir name.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/7
        - id: well.formation
          label: Formation
          description: Producing formation or target zone.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/8
        - id: well.hole_size
          label: Hole Size
          description: Hole size for current interval.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/9
        - id: well.mud_weight
          label: Mud Weight
          description: Mud weight in pounds per gallon when stated.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/10
        - id: well.perforated_intervals
          label: Perforated Intervals
          description: Perforation intervals with top, bottom, stage, and date when available.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/11
        - id: well.stimulation_summary
          label: Stimulation Summary
          description: Fracturing, acidizing, stimulation, or treatment summary.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/12
        - id: well.total_depth
          label: Total Depth
          description: Total measured depth.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/13
        - id: well.true_vertical_depth
          label: True Vertical Depth
          description: True vertical depth at report cutoff.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/14
        - id: well.well_count
          label: Well Count
          description: Number of wells included in the report.
          dataType: integer
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/2/properties/15
    - id: operator
      label: Operator
      description: An organization accountable for operating an energy asset.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3
      properties:
        - id: operator.operator_name
          label: Operator Name
          description: Operating company.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/0
        - id: operator.company_representative
          label: Company Representative
          description: Company man, drilling supervisor, or report approver.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/1
        - id: operator.customer_representative
          label: Customer Representative
          description: Customer approver or company representative.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/2
        - id: operator.report_preparer
          label: Report Preparer
          description: Person or role preparing the report.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/3/properties/3
    - id: field_service_job
      label: Field Service Job
      description: A governed unit of field work, labor, equipment, and material.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4
      properties:
        - id: field_service_job.job_type
          label: Job Type
          description: Type of service performed.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/0
        - id: field_service_job.service_company_name
          label: Service Company Name
          description: Service provider issuing the ticket.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/1
        - id: field_service_job.service_date
          label: Service Date
          description: Date service was performed.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/2
        - id: field_service_job.ticket_number
          label: Ticket Number
          description: Field ticket number.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/3
        - id: field_service_job.approval_status
          label: Approval Status
          description: Signed, pending, disputed, rejected, or other approval status.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/4
        - id: field_service_job.contractor_name
          label: Contractor Name
          description: Drilling contractor or rig contractor.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/5
        - id: field_service_job.equipment_lines
          label: Equipment Lines
          description: Equipment charges with unit, hours, rate, and amount.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/6
        - id: field_service_job.job_description
          label: Job Description
          description: Narrative description of the work performed.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/7
        - id: field_service_job.labor_lines
          label: Labor Lines
          description: Labor charges with role, hours, rate, and amount.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/8
        - id: field_service_job.material_lines
          label: Material Lines
          description: Material charges with item, quantity, unit price, and amount.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/9
        - id: field_service_job.service_supervisor
          label: Service Supervisor
          description: Service company supervisor.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/4/properties/10
    - id: production_measurement
      label: Production Measurement
      description: A dated measurement of produced volumes, inventory, sales, or downtime.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5
      properties:
        - id: production_measurement.gas_volume_mcf
          label: Gas Volume Mcf
          description: Gas production volume in thousand cubic feet.
          dataType: decimal
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/0
        - id: production_measurement.oil_volume_bbl
          label: Oil Volume Bbl
          description: Oil production volume in barrels.
          dataType: decimal
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/1
        - id: production_measurement.production_date
          label: Production Date
          description: Production date or reporting period end date.
          dataType: date
          required: true
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/2
        - id: production_measurement.downtime_hours
          label: Downtime Hours
          description: Non-productive time or downtime hours.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/3
        - id: production_measurement.beginning_inventory_bbl
          label: Beginning Inventory Bbl
          description: Beginning tank or lease oil inventory.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/4
        - id: production_measurement.downtime_reason
          label: Downtime Reason
          description: Reason for downtime or shut-in status.
          dataType: string
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/5
        - id: production_measurement.ending_inventory_bbl
          label: Ending Inventory Bbl
          description: Ending tank or lease oil inventory.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/6
        - id: production_measurement.flared_gas_mcf
          label: Flared Gas Mcf
          description: Gas flared volume.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/7
        - id: production_measurement.initial_gas_rate_mcfpd
          label: Initial Gas Rate Mcfpd
          description: Initial gas production rate in thousand cubic feet per day.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/8
        - id: production_measurement.initial_oil_rate_bpd
          label: Initial Oil Rate Bpd
          description: Initial oil production rate in barrels per day.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/9
        - id: production_measurement.initial_water_rate_bpd
          label: Initial Water Rate Bpd
          description: Initial water production rate in barrels per day.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/10
        - id: production_measurement.ngl_volume_bbl
          label: Ngl Volume Bbl
          description: Natural gas liquids volume in barrels.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/11
        - id: production_measurement.sales_volume_bbl
          label: Sales Volume Bbl
          description: Oil or liquids sales volume.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/12
        - id: production_measurement.water_volume_bbl
          label: Water Volume Bbl
          description: Produced water volume in barrels.
          dataType: decimal
          required: false
          identifier: false
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/5/properties/13
    - id: person
      label: Person
      description: A human being identified in a governed business context.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6
      properties:
        - id: person.person_id
          label: Person identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the person.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/0
        - id: person.display_name
          label: Display name
          description: Preferred name used in governed interfaces.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/1
        - id: person.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which this person record is valid.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/6/properties/2
    - id: organization
      label: Organization
      description: A governed legal, public, or operating organization.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7
      properties:
        - id: organization.organization_id
          label: Organization identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the organization.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/0
        - id: organization.legal_name
          label: Legal name
          description: Registered or otherwise authoritative organization name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/1
        - id: organization.organization_type
          label: Organization type
          description: Governed classification of the organization.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/7/properties/2
    - id: agent
      label: Agent
      description: A human or software actor authorized to perform governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8
      properties:
        - id: agent.agent_id
          label: Agent identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the actor.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/0
        - id: agent.agent_type
          label: Agent type
          description: Whether the actor is human, service, or automated.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/1
        - id: agent.active
          label: Active
          description: Whether the agent is currently authorized.
          dataType: boolean
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/8/properties/2
    - id: location
      label: Location
      description: A physical, administrative, or virtual place relevant to governed activity.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9
      properties:
        - id: location.location_id
          label: Location identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the location.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/0
        - id: location.name
          label: Location name
          description: Human-readable location name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/1
        - id: location.country_code
          label: Country code
          description: ISO country code when applicable.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/9/properties/2
    - id: document
      label: Document
      description: A governed information artifact with identity, version, and provenance.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10
      properties:
        - id: document.document_id
          label: Document identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the document.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/0
        - id: document.title
          label: Title
          description: Authoritative document title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/1
        - id: document.version
          label: Version
          description: Document version or revision.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/2
        - id: document.issued_at
          label: Issued at
          description: Time at which the document was issued.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/10/properties/3
    - id: event
      label: Event
      description: A governed occurrence bounded by time and business meaning.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11
      properties:
        - id: event.event_id
          label: Event identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/0
        - id: event.event_type
          label: Event type
          description: Governed classification of the event.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/1
        - id: event.occurred_at
          label: Occurred at
          description: Time at which the event occurred.
          dataType: datetime
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/11/properties/2
    - id: asset
      label: Asset
      description: A governed physical, digital, or financial resource.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12
      properties:
        - id: asset.asset_id
          label: Asset identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the asset.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/0
        - id: asset.name
          label: Asset name
          description: Human-readable asset name.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/1
        - id: asset.asset_type
          label: Asset type
          description: Governed classification of the asset.
          dataType: string
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/12/properties/2
    - id: policy
      label: Policy
      description: A versioned rule or standard governing decisions and actions.
      sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13
      properties:
        - id: policy.policy_id
          label: Policy identifier
          description: Stable governed identifier for the policy.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          identifier: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/0
        - id: policy.title
          label: Policy title
          description: Authoritative policy title.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/1
        - id: policy.version
          label: Version
          description: Approved policy version.
          dataType: string
          required: true
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/2
        - id: policy.effective_from
          label: Effective from
          description: Time from which the policy applies.
          dataType: datetime
          sourcePath: /ontology/entityTypes/13/properties/3
  relationships:
    - id: outage_event_affected_asset
      label: AFFECTED_ASSET
      description: Outage Event references Grid Asset through Affected Asset.
      sourceTypeId: outage_event
      targetTypeId: grid_asset
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/0
    - id: operated_by
      label: OPERATED_BY
      description: Well operated by Operator.
      sourceTypeId: well
      targetTypeId: operator
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/1
    - id: performed_at
      label: PERFORMED_AT
      description: Field Service Job performed at Well.
      sourceTypeId: field_service_job
      targetTypeId: well
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/2
    - id: measures
      label: MEASURES
      description: Production Measurement measures Well.
      sourceTypeId: production_measurement
      targetTypeId: well
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/3
    - id: member_of
      label: MEMBER_OF
      description: A person is affiliated with an organization.
      sourceTypeId: person
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/4
    - id: acts_for
      label: ACTS_FOR
      description: An agent acts on behalf of an organization.
      sourceTypeId: agent
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/5
    - id: located_at
      label: LOCATED_AT
      description: An organization operates at a location.
      sourceTypeId: organization
      targetTypeId: location
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/6
    - id: documents
      label: DOCUMENTS
      description: A document records or describes an event.
      sourceTypeId: document
      targetTypeId: event
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/7
    - id: involves_asset
      label: INVOLVES_ASSET
      description: An event involves a governed asset.
      sourceTypeId: event
      targetTypeId: asset
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/8
    - id: governed_by_policy
      label: GOVERNED_BY_POLICY
      description: An event is governed by an applicable policy.
      sourceTypeId: event
      targetTypeId: policy
      cardinality: many-to-many
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/9
    - id: owned_by_organization
      label: OWNED_BY_ORGANIZATION
      description: An asset is owned or stewarded by an organization.
      sourceTypeId: asset
      targetTypeId: organization
      cardinality: many-to-one
      sourcePath: /ontology/relationshipTypes/10
